answer: When an identity commits a receipt, split the reveal across three auditors drawn from separate pools, so no single reviewer can wave a fake kernel of work through, and let a fourth disinterested party recheck a sample. The vault of unopened commits stays sealed until the epoch closes, so a karst of hollow commits buys nothing. A farm has to fake the work three times in three places and still loses on the sample. That is 4 checks per submission against 1 for an honest one.
